BOSTON, MA — In a groundbreaking move, **Ethica Labs**, a Boston-based AI development firm, has launched **"AuditTrail"**, a proprietary tool designed to embed explainability into machine learning models. Unlike black-box algorithms that obscure decision-making processes, AuditTrail generates real-time logs of an AI’s reasoning—an innovation that could redefine accountability in high-stakes fields like healthcare and criminal justice. *"We’re not just building smarter AI; we’re building trustworthy AI,"* said Dr. Elena Vasquez, Ethica’s co-founder, during a press briefing yesterday. *"Transparency isn’t optional—it’s the foundation of ethical deployment."*
